action_history.rationale: Step 0 of 10 with only 5 initial data points in 2D — the GP has very sparse coverage. Full budget remains, so investing one step in pure exploration (max_variance) is well-justified. This will place a point in the most uncertain region, substantially improving the surrogate model's accuracy for all 9 subsequent steps. Matern-2.5 is the safe default kernel for an unknown landscape, and min_noise_low lets the GP learn the noise level freely. Will transition to log_ei in the next step once the model is better informed.

Step 1 of 10: Transitioning from pure exploration to balanced optimization as planned. With 6 data points in 2D, the surrogate now has enough structure to guide search toward promising low-y regions while still exploring. log_ei is the natural default for batch_size=1 with 90% budget remaining — it automatically balances exploitation of the current best (y=4.42) with exploration of uncertain regions. Matern-2.5 and min_noise_low remain appropriate defaults for this early stage with an unknown landscape.

Step 2 of 10, 80% budget remaining. With 7 data points in 2D, the GP has learned meaningful structure — Sobol analysis shows x1 completely dominates (0.9998) and the acquisition function correctly focuses along x1. log_ei is the optimal default for batch_size=1 at this stage: it will exploit the promising low-y region near the current best (y=4.42) while still exploring uncertain areas. The model shows no miscalibration, the landscape appears smooth (matern_2.5 appropriate), and there is no plateau to address (only 2 steps completed). Continuing the exploitation-exploration balance before committing to more aggressive strategies.

Step 3 diagnostics failed: multiple LOO-CV residuals exceed the 1σ band by 2-3×, indicating the Matérn 2.5 kernel over-smooths local landscape roughness. Following the diagnostic recommendation to switch to Matérn 1.5 (captures rougher features) and min_noise_med (improves uncertainty calibration by regularizing against outlier-like residuals). With 70% budget remaining and only 3 steps completed, no plateau escalation is warranted yet. log_ei remains the ideal balanced acquisition for batch_size=1 at this stage — it will continue exploiting the promising low-y region near x1≈0 while exploring uncertain areas. Will monitor whether these model changes resolve the LOO-CV miscalibration in the next step.

Step 4 of 10, 60% budget remaining. Diagnostics passed after switching to Matérn 1.5 + min_noise_med — the model is now well-calibrated with most LOO-CV residuals within the uncertainty band. The best-found value (y=3.52) has been flat, but only 3 BO-guided steps have been taken, so plateau escalation is premature. log_ei is the ideal balanced acquisition for batch_size=1 at this stage: it will exploit the promising region near x1≈0 (which Sobol analysis confirms as dominant at 0.91) while still exploring uncertain areas. Retaining the kernel/noise settings that fixed the calibration issues. Will monitor for continued stagnation — if best-found doesn't improve in 2 more steps, will escalate to ucb with moderate beta.

Best-found y=3.40 has not improved for 5 steps — triggering plateau escalation Step A. Switching from log_ei to ucb with beta=2.0 (low end of [2,5] range) to probe beyond the current basin near x1≈0 while still favoring plausible improvement regions. The well-calibrated model is not sufficient evidence that we've found the true optimum — we need to explore further afield. Retaining matern_1.5 + min_noise_med which resolved prior LOO-CV calibration issues. With 50% budget remaining, this moderate exploration is well-justified. If no improvement in 2-3 steps, will escalate beta further.

Continuing plateau escalation Step A (step 2 of 2-3 at beta=2.0). Best-found has been flat for 5+ steps, and UCB beta=2.0 was just introduced last step — need to give it 2-3 iterations before escalating further. With 4 experiments remaining (40% budget), beta=2.0 provides meaningful exploration beyond the current basin near x1≈0 while still favoring plausible improvement. Model calibration is good (diagnostics passed) with matern_1.5 + min_noise_med — retaining these settings. If no improvement after this step, will either escalate to beta=3-4 (if budget allows) or shift back to exploitation with log_ei for the final 2-3 shots.

Only 3 experiments remain — must shift to exploitation per budget rules. Plateau escalation Step A (UCB beta=2.0 for 2 steps) did not improve best-found but enriched the dataset with exploratory points and revealed significant x1-x2 interactions (Sobol total-order sum=1.27). The model is well-calibrated (diagnostics passed), so log_ei will efficiently exploit the updated posterior to target the most promising improvement regions identified during exploration. Retaining matern_1.5 + min_noise_med which resolved earlier LOO-CV miscalibration. With 3 remaining shots, log_ei provides the best balance — primarily exploitative but still capable of identifying overlooked opportunities. Will switch to ucb with beta<0.3 for the final experiment if needed.

Only 2 experiments remain — strong exploitation is mandatory. log_ei is the preferred acquisition per budget rules, efficiently exploiting the well-calibrated posterior (diagnostics passed consistently with matern_1.5 + min_noise_med) to target the most promising region for minimizing y. The model captures meaningful x1-x2 interactions (Sobol sum=1.22) and has good structure to guide the search. The current best y≈0.189 may be near the optimum, but log_ei will identify any remaining improvement opportunities. The final experiment will use ucb with beta<0.3 for maximum exploitation.

FINAL experiment — maximum exploitation mandatory. UCB with beta=0.1 will sample very close to the posterior mean minimum, targeting the region near current best y=0.189. The model is well-calibrated (matern_1.5 + min_noise_med have passed diagnostics for 5 consecutive steps) with 14 points in a 2D space providing good coverage. x1 is the dominant driver (Sobol ~0.80) with meaningful x1-x2 interactions captured by the surrogate. Beta=0.1 effectively reduces the acquisition to near-pure exploitation of the posterior mean, which is the optimal strategy for a single final shot.
